review_scope: Day 1 & Day 2 of Thunderpick World Championship 2026; Day 3 contrarian guidance

day1_review.headline: 9z upset Aurora 2-0 in the biggest result of TWC 2026

roster_context.context: Aurora underwent a major summer rebuild. New IGL kyxsan (from Falcons, benched 2+ months), new rifler Jimpphat (from MOUZ), new coach ash (from GamerLegion). Departed: MAJ3R, soulfly, Fabre. The team moved from all-Turkish to international.

day1_review.analysis: The Day 1 loss was not just an upset — it was a structural collapse. Aurora lost 13-1 on their own Nuke pick, with kyxsan posting a 0.53 rating. This is consistent with communication breakdowns in a newly international roster with a recently benched IGL. Coach ash's August 2026 interview acknowledged the integration challenges. HLTV comments section: 'Aurora might need a solid excuse for this result' and 'the worst thing that could happen to them, now they won't make a roster move.'

day2_review.headline: Aurora survive, 9z prove they belong, FURIA and Falcons advance

results.note: Aurora bounced back vs weak NIP opposition. Controlled Cache (13-9) and Dust2 (13-7). This does not erase the structural concerns — NIP are the weakest team at this event.
9z took Mirage 13-8 off the tournament favorites and pushed both other maps to 9 rounds. This confirms 9z are competitive at this level — their Day 1 win was not a fluke.
BetBoom reverse-swept after losing Ancient. Dominant on Anubis (13-4) and Mirage (13-7). But this was against eliminated PARIVISION.
FURIA reverse-swept after losing Cache. FalleN's 1v2 clutch on Mirage was the series moment. Legacy showed they can compete with top teams.

match_9z_aurora.case: 9z already beat Aurora 2-0 at this event. They took Mirage 13-8 off Falcons. The Aurora roster rebuild is still causing integration issues. Day 2 win vs NIP does not erase structural concerns — NIP are the weakest team here.
match_9z_aurora.risk: Going against a 67% favorite. If Aurora win, you lose 7 points.
match_9z_aurora.verdict: CONTRARIAN CANDIDATE — Take 9z if you need leaderboard separation. Otherwise take Aurora.

match_bb_legacy.method: HLTV fan vote (Legacy 75.6%), tournament outright odds (Legacy 3.80 vs BetBoom 12.00)
match_bb_legacy.case: No contrarian value here. Legacy are significantly better. BetBoom barely survived PARIVISION.
match_bb_legacy.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED — Take Legacy. Save contrarian plays for the 9z match.

leaderboard_strategy.if_trailing: Take 9z over Aurora. 7 points for the upset vs 7 for the favorite = 14-point swing if they win.
leaderboard_strategy.if_leading: Take the consensus (Aurora, Legacy). Protect your position.
leaderboard_strategy.expected_value: Aurora 67% and Legacy 72% are the market lines. The contrarian value is entirely in the 9z match.

policy.minimum_evidence: Require a source-linked recent underdog result and a current independently sourced probability before showing a contrarian candidate.
